sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: Over the past years, the cut-off frequencies of advanced millimeter wave and submillimeter wave semiconductor technologies exceeded 1 THz. These technologies enable the realization of high-resolution radar systems, ultra-high data rate wireless communication links, as well as advanced meteorological instruments [1]. sections.title: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text_preview: Three advanced metamorphic HEMT technologies have been presented, demonstrating excellent device and circuit performance up to 730 GHz. Based on these technologies, a set of state-of-the-art low-noise amplifiers, ultrabroadband power amplifiers and multifunctional transmitreceive MMICs have been successfully developed.
